description: This file defines the CountryAPI class, which provides a REST API endpoint for retrieving country data within the OrangeHRM installer module. It extends an abstract REST controller and implements a handleGet method to return a list of countries.

classes.name: CountryAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller providing access to country data for the installer process, extending the abstract installer REST controller.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the API, returning a list of country data via the InstanceCreationHelper.
